labels.title: Labels
labels.subtitle: Print barcode labels for products, lots and locations
labels.nothingSelectedHint: Pick at least one item to print labels for
labels.sheetHint: Laid out on A4 · {perSheet} per sheet
labels.printHint: Printer settings: A4, margins none, headers and footers off
labels.noBarcodeWarning: This product has no barcode yet — its SKU will be used instead
labels.encodingNote: Internal barcodes encode identifiers that already exist — SKU, lot number, location code — as Code 128. Nothing is invented.
labels.factoryNote: Products with a factory EAN-13 are scanned as they are. Do not sticker over them.
labels.shelfNote: Products with no barcode get one label on the shelf edge, not a sticker on every piece.
labels.lotNote: Lot labels are the primary scan target: one per drum or handling unit.
labels.noBarcodeShelf: No barcode – use a shelf label
labels.qcBoxNote: Labels print identity plus a blank QC block to complete by pen (tick, inspector, date). Current QC status comes from scanning, never from the label.
